scope: Complete creature, melee and aura rules in one persistent transaction per step; Core content without Official Packages. No connected-player capacity claim.
concurrency: Other owned Package test drivers paused between tests; current tests finished before timing. The existing live Realm and unrelated processes were left running.
interpretation: Three warmups and twenty measured samples at each creature count. Each sample contains twelve paired steps; p95 is pooled per-step latency, not a percentile of replay averages. CPU excludes the CLI subscriber. Maximum sampled resident memory and process peak include different lifetime effects; native memory is not uniformly lower.
